svg.title: Control plan flow + 17 gates – drawing 44-01
svg.text: Control plan flow – routings of item 2 with the 17 quality gates
Box = operation (op no. · machine type). Diamond = quality gate after the operation: what is checked · gauge · frequency. CC = critical, SC = significant.
CC gate – function / safety / customer: 100 % or SPC with Cpk ≥ 1.67
SC gate – significant: SPC with Cpk ≥ 1.33
Accent box = operation followed by a gate. Every gate has a reaction plan in the control plan.
Control plan row = characteristic · spec · method / gauge · sample / frequency ·
who · control · reaction plan. 55 characteristics in bsfqa_data.js (CHARS).
